ticket_assignments_assignee_check.name: ticket_assignments_assignee_check
ticket_assignments_assignee_check.value: ((stage = 'supervisor'::assignment_stage) AND (assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (assignee_technician_id IS NULL)) OR ((stage = 'technician'::assignment_stage) AND (assignee_technician_id IS NOT NULL))

notifications_check.name: notifications_check
notifications_check.value: (recipient_user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (recipient_requester_id IS NOT NULL)

public.v_metrics_aging.name: v_metrics_aging
public.v_metrics_aging.definition: SELECT id, folio, status, team_id, category_id, priority_id, reported_at, now() - reported_at AS age, work_calendar_overlap(ticket_calendar(id), reported_at, now()) AS age_labor, ticket_time_by_kind(id, 'wait_start'::time_span_kind) AS wait_start_time, ticket_time_by_kind(id, 'pause'::time_span_kind) AS pause_time FROM tickets t WHERE status <> ALL (ARRAY['closed'::ticket_status, 'rejected'::ticket_status, 'cancelled'::ticket_status, 'duplicate'::ticket_status])

public.v_ticket_metrics_base.name: v_ticket_metrics_base
public.v_ticket_metrics_base.definition: SELECT id, ticket_number, folio, status, building_id, category_id, priority_id, team_id, reported_at, closed_at, ticket_time_total(id) AS total_time, ticket_time_net(id) AS net_time, ticket_time_by_kind(id, 'active_work'::time_span_kind) AS active_work_time, ticket_time_total_laboral(id) AS total_time_labor, ticket_time_net_laboral(id) AS net_time_labor, ticket_time_by_kind_laboral(id, 'active_work'::time_span_kind) AS active_work_time_labor, ticket_time_by_kind(id, 'supervisor_response'::time_span_kind) AS response_time, ticket_time_by_kind_laboral(id, 'supervisor_response'::time_span_kind) AS response_time_labor, ticket_time_by_kind(id, 'technician_assignment'::time_span_kind) AS assignment_time, ticket_time_by_kind_laboral(id, 'technician_assignment'::time_span_kind) AS assignment_time_labor, ticket_time_by_kind(id, 'reassignment'::time_span_kind) AS reassignment_time, ticket_time_by_kind_laboral(id, 'reassignment'::time_span_kind) AS reassignment_time_labor, ticket_time_by_kind(id, 'wait_start'::time_span_kind) AS wait_start_time, ticket_time_by_kind_laboral(id, 'wait_start'::time_span_kind) AS wait_start_time_labor, ticket_time_by_kind(id, 'pause'::time_span_kind) AS pause_time, ticket_time_by_kind_laboral(id, 'pause'::time_span_kind) AS pause_time_labor, ticket_time_by_kind(id, 'validation'::time_span_kind) AS validation_time, ticket_time_by_kind_laboral(id, 'validation'::time_span_kind) AS validation_time_labor, ticket_time_by_kind(id, 'claim'::time_span_kind) AS claim_time, ticket_time_by_kind_laboral(id, 'claim'::time_span_kind) AS claim_time_labor, requester_id, dependency_id, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_events e WHERE e.ticket_id = t.id AND e.type = 'reassigned_supervisor'::event_type)) AS reassigned_supervisor, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_events e WHERE e.ticket_id = t.id AND e.type = 'reassigned_technician'::event_type)) AS reassigned_technician, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_captures c WHERE c.ticket_id = t.id)) AS recaptured, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_events e WHERE e.ticket_id = t.id AND e.type = 'reopened'::event_type)) AS reopened, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evidence ev WHERE ev.ticket_id = t.id AND ev.type = 'request'::evidence_type)) AS has_request_evidence, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evidence ev WHERE ev.ticket_id = t.id AND ev.type = 'before'::evidence_type)) AS has_before_evidence, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evidence ev WHERE ev.ticket_id = t.id AND ev.type = 'after'::evidence_type)) AS has_after_evidence, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_validations v WHERE v.ticket_id = t.id AND v.validator_role = 'requester'::text)) AS validated_requester, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_validations v WHERE v.ticket_id = t.id AND v.validator_role = 'supervisor'::text)) AS validated_supervisor, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM ticket_captures c WHERE c.ticket_id = t.id) AS recapture_count, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM ticket_events e WHERE e.ticket_id = t.id AND e.type = 'reopened'::event_type) AS reopen_count, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM ticket_participants p WHERE p.ticket_id = t.id AND p.participation_type = 'auxiliary'::participation_type) AS auxiliary_count, ( SELECT sum(COALESCE(p.ended_at, now()) - p.started_at) AS sum FROM ticket_participants p WHERE p.ticket_id = t.id AND p.participation_type = 'auxiliary'::participation_type) AS auxiliary_time, ticket_time_by_kind_extra(id, 'active_work'::time_span_kind) AS active_work_time_extra FROM tickets t WHERE status <> 'duplicate'::ticket_status

public.v_metrics_by_dimension.name: v_metrics_by_dimension
public.v_metrics_by_dimension.definition: SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(m.team_id) = 0 THEN 'team'::text WHEN GROUPING(m.category_id) = 0 THEN 'category'::text WHEN GROUPING(m.building_id) = 0 THEN 'building'::text WHEN GROUPING(m.dependency_id) = 0 THEN 'dependency'::text ELSE 'requester'::text END AS dimension, COALESCE(m.team_id, m.category_id, m.building_id, m.dependency_id, m.requester_id) AS dimension_id, COALESCE(tm.name, cat.name, bld.name, dep.name, req.full_name) AS dimension_name, count(*) AS tickets, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.reassigned_supervisor) AS reassigned, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.recaptured) AS recaptured, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.reopened) AS reopened, round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.reassigned_supervisor)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 4) AS reassignment_rate, round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.recaptured)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 4) AS recapture_rate, round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.reopened)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 4) AS reopen_rate, round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'closed'::ticket_status AND NOT m.reopened)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'closed'::ticket_status), 0)::numeric, 4) AS first_time_fix_rate, avg(m.response_time) AS avg_response_time, avg(m.assignment_time) AS avg_assignment_time, avg(m.reassignment_time) AS avg_reassignment_time, avg(m.wait_start_time) AS avg_wait_start_time, avg(m.active_work_time) AS avg_active_work_time, avg(m.pause_time) AS avg_pause_time, avg(m.validation_time) AS avg_validation_time, avg(m.total_time) AS avg_total_time, avg(m.net_time) AS avg_net_time, avg(m.total_time_labor) AS avg_total_time_labor, avg(m.net_time_labor) AS avg_net_time_labor, avg(m.active_work_time_labor) AS avg_active_work_time_labor FROM v_ticket_metrics_base m LEFT JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = m.team_id LEFT JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = m.category_id LEFT JOIN buildings bld ON bld.id = m.building_id LEFT JOIN dependencies dep ON dep.id = m.dependency_id LEFT JOIN requesters req ON req.id = m.requester_id GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((m.team_id, tm.name), (m.category_id, cat.name), (m.building_id, bld.name), (m.dependency_id, dep.name), (m.requester_id, req.full_name))

public.v_metrics_by_technician.name: v_metrics_by_technician
public.v_metrics_by_technician.definition: SELECT p.technician_id, tech.full_name AS technician_name, count(DISTINCT p.ticket_id) AS tickets, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.participation_type = 'leader'::participation_type) AS leader_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.participation_type = 'auxiliary'::participation_type) AS auxiliary_count, sum(COALESCE(p.ended_at, now()) - p.started_at) AS participation_time, sum(work_calendar_overlap(ticket_calendar(p.ticket_id), p.started_at, COALESCE(p.ended_at, now()))) AS participation_time_labor, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM ticket_assignments a WHERE a.assignee_technician_id = p.technician_id AND a.stage = 'technician'::assignment_stage) AS assigned_count, sum(COALESCE(p.ended_at, now()) - p.started_at) - sum(work_calendar_overlap(ticket_calendar(p.ticket_id), p.started_at, COALESCE(p.ended_at, now()))) AS participation_time_extra FROM ticket_participants p JOIN technicians tech ON tech.id = p.technician_id GROUP BY p.technician_id, tech.full_name

public.v_metrics_duplicate_alerts.name: v_metrics_duplicate_alerts
public.v_metrics_duplicate_alerts.definition: SELECT COALESCE(decision, 'pending'::text) AS decision, count(*) AS candidates, count(DISTINCT ticket_id) AS tickets FROM ticket_duplicate_candidates c GROUP BY (COALESCE(decision, 'pending'::text))

public.v_metrics_duplicate_tickets.name: v_metrics_duplicate_tickets
public.v_metrics_duplicate_tickets.definition: SELECT id, building_id, category_id, team_id, dependency_id, requester_id, reported_at, ( SELECT min(e.occurred_at) AS min FROM ticket_events e WHERE e.ticket_id = t.id AND e.type = 'duplicate_marked'::event_type) AS marked_at, (( SELECT min(e.occurred_at) AS min FROM ticket_events e WHERE e.ticket_id = t.id AND e.type = 'duplicate_marked'::event_type)) - reported_at AS time_to_mark FROM tickets t WHERE status = 'duplicate'::ticket_status

public.v_metrics_duplicates_by_dimension.name: v_metrics_duplicates_by_dimension
public.v_metrics_duplicates_by_dimension.definition: WITH agg AS ( SELECT GROUPING(t.team_id) AS g_team, GROUPING(t.building_id) AS g_building, GROUPING(t.dependency_id) AS g_dependency, GROUPING(t.requester_id) AS g_requester, t.team_id, t.building_id, t.dependency_id, t.requester_id, count(*) AS tickets, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'duplicate'::ticket_status) AS duplicates FROM tickets t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.team_id), (t.building_id), (t.dependency_id), (t.requester_id)) ) SELECT CASE WHEN agg.g_team = 0 THEN 'team'::text WHEN agg.g_building = 0 THEN 'building'::text WHEN agg.g_dependency = 0 THEN 'dependency'::text ELSE 'requester'::text END AS dimension, COALESCE(agg.team_id, agg.building_id, agg.dependency_id, agg.requester_id) AS dimension_id, COALESCE(tm.name, bld.name, dep.name, req.full_name) AS dimension_name, agg.tickets, agg.duplicates, round(agg.duplicates::numeric / NULLIF(agg.tickets, 0)::numeric, 4) AS duplicate_rate FROM agg LEFT JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = agg.team_id LEFT JOIN buildings bld ON bld.id = agg.building_id LEFT JOIN dependencies dep ON dep.id = agg.dependency_id LEFT JOIN requesters req ON req.id = agg.requester_id

public.v_metrics_pauses_by_reason.name: v_metrics_pauses_by_reason
public.v_metrics_pauses_by_reason.definition: SELECT r.id AS reason_id, r.name AS reason_name, count(*) AS pauses, count(DISTINCT p.ticket_id) AS tickets, sum(COALESCE(p.closed_at, now()) - p.opened_at) AS pause_time, sum(work_calendar_overlap(ticket_calendar(p.ticket_id), p.opened_at, COALESCE(p.closed_at, now()))) AS pause_time_labor FROM ticket_pauses p JOIN reasons r ON r.id = p.reason_id GROUP BY r.id, r.name

public.v_metrics_reject_cancel_by_reason.name: v_metrics_reject_cancel_by_reason
public.v_metrics_reject_cancel_by_reason.definition: SELECT e.type AS event_type, r.id AS reason_id, r.name AS reason_name, count(*) AS tickets FROM ticket_events e JOIN reasons r ON r.id = e.reason_id WHERE e.type = ANY (ARRAY['rejected'::event_type, 'cancelled'::event_type]) GROUP BY e.type, r.id, r.name

public.v_metrics_routing.name: v_metrics_routing
public.v_metrics_routing.definition: SELECT id, folio, status, building_id, team_id, reported_at, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM ticket_offers o WHERE o.ticket_id = t.id) AS offers_count, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM ticket_offers o WHERE o.ticket_id = t.id AND o.status = 'offered'::offer_status) AS pending_offers, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM ticket_offers o WHERE o.ticket_id = t.id AND o.status = 'taken'::offer_status) AS taken_offers, (( SELECT min(o.resolved_at) AS min FROM ticket_offers o WHERE o.ticket_id = t.id AND o.status = 'taken'::offer_status)) - reported_at AS time_to_take FROM tickets t

public.v_metrics_satisfaction.name: v_metrics_satisfaction
public.v_metrics_satisfaction.definition: SELECT round(avg(score), 3) AS average_score, count(*) AS ratings, count(*) FILTER (WHERE score = 1) AS score_1, count(*) FILTER (WHERE score = 2) AS score_2, count(*) FILTER (WHERE score = 3) AS score_3, count(*) FILTER (WHERE score = 4) AS score_4, count(*) FILTER (WHERE score = 5) AS score_5 FROM ticket_ratings r

public.v_ticket_sla.name: v_ticket_sla
public.v_ticket_sla.definition: WITH base AS ( SELECT t.id, t.ticket_number, t.folio, t.status, t.description, t.priority_id, t.service_type_id, t.building_id, t.category_id, t.team_id, t.reported_at, t.closed_at, COALESCE(st.target_minutes, pr.target_minutes) AS target_minutes, CASE WHEN t.closed_at IS NULL THEN NULL::numeric WHEN (( SELECT instance_settings.sla_clock_mode FROM instance_settings LIMIT 1)) = 'laboral'::text THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM ticket_time_total_laboral(t.id)) / 60::numeric ELSE EXTRACT(epoch FROM t.closed_at - t.reported_at) / 60::numeric END AS resolution_minutes FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN service_types st ON st.id = t.service_type_id LEFT JOIN priorities pr ON pr.id = t.priority_id WHERE t.status <> 'duplicate'::ticket_status ) SELECT id, ticket_number, folio, status, description, priority_id, service_type_id, building_id, category_id, team_id, reported_at, closed_at, target_minutes, resolution_minutes, CASE WHEN resolution_minutes IS NOT NULL AND target_minutes IS NOT NULL THEN resolution_minutes <= target_minutes::numeric ELSE NULL::boolean END AS meets FROM base

public.v_metrics_sla.name: v_metrics_sla
public.v_metrics_sla.definition: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE target_minutes IS NOT NULL AND closed_at IS NOT NULL) AS with_target, count(*) FILTER (WHERE meets) AS met, round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE meets)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE target_minutes IS NOT NULL AND closed_at IS NOT NULL), 0)::numeric, 4) AS compliance_rate, avg(target_minutes) FILTER (WHERE target_minutes IS NOT NULL AND closed_at IS NOT NULL) AS avg_target_minutes, avg(resolution_minutes) FILTER (WHERE target_minutes IS NOT NULL AND closed_at IS NOT NULL) AS avg_resolution_minutes FROM v_ticket_sla

public.v_metrics_sla_by_priority.name: v_metrics_sla_by_priority
public.v_metrics_sla_by_priority.definition: SELECT pr.id AS priority_id, pr.name AS priority_name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.target_minutes IS NOT NULL AND s.closed_at IS NOT NULL) AS with_target, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.meets) AS met, round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.meets)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.target_minutes IS NOT NULL AND s.closed_at IS NOT NULL), 0)::numeric, 4) AS compliance_rate FROM v_ticket_sla s JOIN priorities pr ON pr.id = s.priority_id GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name

public.v_ticket_timeline.name: v_ticket_timeline
public.v_ticket_timeline.definition: SELECT e.id, e.ticket_id, e.cycle, e.type, e.payload, e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at, e.actor_id, actor.full_name AS actor_name, e.subject_user_id, subject.full_name AS subject_user_name, e.subject_technician_id, technician.full_name AS subject_technician_name, e.reason_id, reason.name AS reason_name FROM ticket_events e LEFT JOIN users actor ON actor.id = e.actor_id LEFT JOIN users subject ON subject.id = e.subject_user_id LEFT JOIN technicians technician ON technician.id = e.subject_technician_id LEFT JOIN reasons reason ON reason.id = e.reason_id
